title: Brix Runtime Shell Outbox Message Contract v1
description: M0 frozen contract evidence for reliable Integration Event and shared message substrate work. Runtime validators are introduced by later milestones.

authority.plan: v3.0.10-Outbox数据可靠性最小实现改造计划.md

envelope.tenantScopeRule: TENANT requires tenantId; PLATFORM must not invent tenantId
envelope.identityRule: Runtime constructs producerPluginId, scope, tenantId, trace and delivery context
envelope.wireTypeRule: eventType is the public fact type; Java FQCN is not the wire SSoT
envelope.replayIdentityRule: Relay retry and replay preserve eventId

outboxRecord.transportRouteRule: Broker topic or route is resolved by L2B from Manifest and Schema Registry and is not a business contract field

inboxRecord.transactionRule: Inbox insert, handler side effects and resulting Outbox records commit in the same Consumer Owner local transaction

inbox: insert handler_id/message_id before handler side effects
unique conflict skips handler side effects
handler failure rolls back inbox insert

payloadRules: tenantId, memberId, profileId and acceptedByIdentityId are required
acceptedAt is the business acceptance time
tenantStatus is the post-acceptance tenant lifecycle status

transport.adapterBoundary: Kafka is the first L2C transport mapping only; reliable policy, Outbox ownership, Relay and Inbox idempotency remain L2B and Data Owner responsibilities
